propositions: PR #128 proposes four uv-lock updates; three are safe (json-repair 0.63.0, genai-prices 0.1.2, botocore 1.43.69) and one is breaking (mcp 2.0.0), deferred to epic 732b
The three safe bumps require no pyproject.toml edits and are admitted by existing version constraints (floors); only uv.lock is modified
mcp version ceiling stays pinned at <2 to block major-version re-proposals; dependabot.yml must ignore semver-major updates for mcp while allowing patch/security fixes
Targeted usage-surface tests (test_structured.py, test_usage_log.py, test_silent_success.py, test_llm_capabilities.py) must pass against all three bumped versions with lint and typecheck gates green
Change lands via Gerrit with rebar-ticket trailer, DCO sign-off, and requires LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 before merge

PR #128 is left open with comments explaining mcp deferral to epic 732b and noting the safe-subset Gerrit change; epic 732b receives urgency comment that mcp v2 is now stable and v1.x is maintenance-mode
